segments.dry: Multiple reviewers with dry skin report lasting hydration, softer and plumper skin, and relief from dry patches and peeling, including one who found it a rare product to fix winter dryness.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: some report irritation, bumps or itchy pimples right away, while others report the toner became their favorite once their skin adjusted after initial breakouts.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes the toner did not work for her husband, who has oily skin.
segments.combination: No combination-skin reports are present in these reviews.
segments.normal: No normal-skin reports are present in these reviews.
segments.mature: No mature-skin reports are present in these reviews.

concerns.dehydration: Many reviewers describe long-lasting hydration (up to 12+ hours), plumper and softer skin, and relief from dryness that persists under makeup; one uses it specifically to counter dryness from prescription retinol.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits the toner with supporting a healthy skin barrier alongside long-day hydration, though this is a single mention rather than a widely repeated claim.
concerns.redness: One dry-skin reviewer with hyperpigmentation reports reduced redness alongside increased plumpness and hydration.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: one reviewer broke out with itchy pimples that come to a head and stopped using it, another had irritation and bumps, and two others experienced initial breakouts or a pimple or two that resolved after continued use with no further issues; several others state explicitly it does not break them out.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports the toner made her pores appear smaller, but this is a single, unconfirmed observation.
concerns.aging: One reviewer credits the toner with a firming effect as part of a broader list of benefits, but this is not corroborated elsewhere.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes the product did not work well for her husband's oily skin, with no further detail on why.

aspects.libelle: Initial breakouts or irritation for some

extraits.texte: I have very dry skin, and hyperpigmentation. This toner reduced redness and makes my skin feel very plump and hydrated. Hydration lasts for over 12hrs. Buying a second bottle today!
